goal: Reconcile the complete approved SDA-v1 473 source-topic mappings and all 134 learning/synthesis/transfer outcomes against actual course teaching and assessments; preserve independent whole-course audit, validation and human publication gates.

in_scope: Non-gate structural cross-reference self-check and precise independent-audit checkpoint
out_of_scope: Changing approved curriculum, agent skills, workflow or task-state implementation
Fabricating deep teaching verification, independent audit verdict or executed test PASS

constraints: MS01–04 sources on main; MS05, MS06, MS07 and MS08 in separate unmerged Draft PRs #100/#110/#121/#131.
All 473 current matrix dispositions remain 'mapped'; matching headings alone does not prove a topic is taught.
No official independent course review JSON/Markdown, strict course checker, regression suite or remote draft_handoff execution was performed here.

definition_of_done.text: Canonical coverage matrix and outcome portfolio assembled with source refs, explicitly checked paths/headings, and any unresolved content-evidence gaps recorded.
An independent coverage/pedagogy review must inspect actual teaching depth for each approved topic, verify outcome assessment items/cross-module dependencies and record official results.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each of 473 source topics receives actual explanatory-teaching judgment, not only a mapped location.
All lesson, synthesis, and capstone outcomes must be checked against real teaching and assessment evidence.
Independent accepted reviews, relevant validators and human acceptance required before course publication.
